card.name: Space before a drug concentration range
card.fires_on: The space right after words like between, in the, is, or from, when a blood-level number such as 10 to 20 mcg/mL is about to follow. It appears in sentences about serum or plasma concentrations.

modes.label: Therapeutic level range
modes.description: The space before the first number of a target serum or plasma level range for a drug.
modes.example: serum total phenytoin concentrations between<< >>10 and 20 mcg
